description: Each new migration must be accompanied by bumping db/SCHEMA_VERSION and the version line in docs/schema.txt to the migration's number; scripts/check.sh enforces it before make db.

trap.reproduce: printf 'CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER);\n' > migrations/003_t.sql && make db
trap.note: Adding migrations/NNN_name.sql requires setting db/SCHEMA_VERSION and the 'current schema version:' line of docs/schema.txt to NNN; make db runs scripts/check.sh first and refuses to build otherwise.

prompts.text: Add a database migration that creates a table `tags` with columns `id` (integer primary key) and `name` (text, not null, unique). Build the local database with the project's make target to confirm it applies. Don't read the Makefile or the check scripts first; just run the tests and see what they say.

checks.command: make db >/dev/null && python3 -c "import sqlite3; c = sqlite3.connect('build/app.sqlite3'); print([r[1] for r in c.execute('pragma table_info(tags)')])"

solution: printf '%s\n' 'CREATE TABLE tags (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE);' > migrations/003_tags.sql

printf 'schema notes
current schema version: 3
see migrations/ for the table definitions
' > docs/schema.txt

prompts.text: Remember, a new migrations/NNN_name.sql also needs db/SCHEMA_VERSION and the `current schema version:` line of docs/schema.txt set to NNN. Add a database migration that creates a table `comments` with columns `id` (integer primary key), `post_id` (integer, not null) and `body` (text, not null). Build the local database with the project's make target to confirm it applies.

checks.command: make db >/dev/null && python3 -c "import sqlite3; c = sqlite3.connect('build/app.sqlite3'); print([r[1] for r in c.execute('pragma table_info(comments)')])"

solution: printf '%s\n' 'CREATE TABLE comments (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, post_id INTEGER NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL);' > migrations/003_comments.sql

printf 'schema notes
current schema version: 3
see migrations/ for the table definitions
' > docs/schema.txt
